_comment: Anna Executa descriptor for the gamentic engine. The comms layer is app/executa.py (stdio JSON-RPC bridge over the unchanged FastAPI app). `anna-app dev` discovers this and spawns `command` (cwd = this dir); `anna-app executa publish` reads slug/name/version/distribution and mints the real tool_id.
name: Gamentic
description: Gamentic game engine, exposed as an Anna Executa. One tool, `request`, replays an HTTP-style call against the engine.

distribution._comment: active=uv: ONE py3-none-any wheel works on every platform. The Agent runs `uv tool install <package_name>` (fetching a managed CPython + the platform dep wheels), then launches the `executable_name` console script. package_name is the direct wheel URL on a GitHub Release, NOT git+https: uv installs a wheel URL over plain HTTPS with no `git` binary on the host (the Agent image ships none), and the wheel's deps all carry wheels up to the newest CPython uv may pick. Bump the URL on each version. `binary` is the legacy per-{os,arch} PyInstaller profile (linux-x86_64 only); `local` is the dev-harness path. Install on the Agent via More -> Agents -> Install Essentials.
